stories.title: Way-Too-Early 2027 MLB Power Rankings: Are the Brewers No. 1?
stories.summary: Milwaukee just won the 2026 World Series -- and we're already looking ahead to next year. Where does your favorite team fall?

stories.title: World Series champs, at last! Milwaukee Brewers barrel their way to the top
stories.summary: After a 57-year drought, one of the game's great franchises has its first championship.

stories.title: Contreras wins World Series MVP, proclaims himself 'best catcher in the world'
stories.summary: Brewers catcher William Contreras capped his stellar postseason run by winning World Series MVP honors after batting .381 and winning 10 of 13 ABS appeals.

stories.title: Champion Brewers trail Dodgers in '27 World Series title odds
stories.summary: Fresh off winning the first World Series title in franchise history, the Brewers find themselves behind the Dodgers as the early favorites to capture next year's crown.

stories.title: Brewers' Murphy rips Yankees in viral celebratory exchange with Bauers
stories.summary: Pat Murphy ripped the Yankees while celebrating the Brewers' World Series victory with Jake Bauers.
